response.justification: Bogdan brings valuable geospatial domain expertise through GISCollective and strong systems/infrastructure experience, but has significant gaps in the primary technical requirement. His C++ experience dates back to 2014-2015 and lacks modern C++ depth, while recent career work focuses on TypeScript, Node.js, and D. Though his demonstrated ability to learn diverse technologies is impressive, ramping from outdated C++ to production-grade modern C++ in a critical pipeline role presents substantial risk. His geospatial background provides compensating merit, making this a borderline candidate.
strengths: Deep geospatial domain knowledge from founding GISCollective platform and building web GIS applications at Green Map, directly applicable to routing tile systems
Strong distributed systems and infrastructure expertise including microservices handling millions of requests/second at Dunnhumby and low-latency optimization experience
Proven track record of rapidly learning diverse technology stacks and working across full technical stack, demonstrating comfort expanding expertise beyond current domains
concerns: C++ experience is significantly outdated (last substantial work in 2014-2015) with no evidence of modern C++ (C++17/C++20) expertise, which is the primary requirement for this role
No Rust experience and recent work is primarily TypeScript and Node.js rather than systems-level languages, creating substantial ramp-up burden for performance-critical pipeline work
No demonstrated experience building production routing systems or navigation pipelines at scale; geospatial work has focused on data collection platforms rather than routing optimization
